title: Divider 分割线
description: 用于分隔内容的细线，可水平或垂直，并可带文字。

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)

props.name: spacing
props.description: Margin around the divider in pixels (top/bottom when horizontal, left/right when vertical)

props.name: flexItem
props.description: Vertical divider inside a flex container: stretches to the container height (align-self: stretch) instead of the 1em inline height

DividerProps.description: The line color comes from the `--divider-color` CSS custom property (default `var(--border-color)`); set it through `className` or `style`.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)

props.name: spacing
props.description: Margin around the divider in pixels (top/bottom when horizontal, left/right when vertical)

props.name: children
props.description: Optional text rendered inside a horizontal divider (ignored when vertical). Without text the divider is a native <hr>

props.name: flexItem
props.description: Vertical divider inside a flex container: stretches to the container height (align-self: stretch) instead of the 1em inline height

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element (<hr>, or <div> when rendering text)

vars.name: --divider-spacing
vars.description: Inline margin around a vertical divider

vars.name: --divider-text-gap
vars.description: Space between the text and the lines

examples.description: 通过 CSS 自定义属性 --divider-color（内联样式、类名或祖先元素）设置线条颜色，并自定义粗细、长度、间距以及 elevation 阴影。
